<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/virtual-devices"}

>

Add a virtual device. Currently, two types are supported:
- `ir`: Infrared virtual device
- `virtual`: Custom virtual device

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
